scope: BASE-01 preparation; mathematical/unit and real full receiver qualification remain required; no new Bstar selected

B0.stopping: fixed nomination count or solver residual stop; not global sparse optimum

ridge.algorithm: OMP40 then ridge on selected support
ridge.source: v3_initial ridge normal equations; new augmented least-squares solve

SBL.algorithm: OMP40 then fixed-noise complex Gaussian type-II ML EM; gamma final threshold
SBL.source: v3_initial SBL posterior/EM; strict double-precision convergence added in supplement_baselines.sbl_em
SBL.stopping: relative gamma and evidence changes<=1e-6; evidence increase tolerance1e-8*max(1,abs(previous))
SBL.failure: raise and retain frame if cap/nonfinite/monotonicity fails
SBL.optimality: EM stationary tolerance, not global ML optimum

group.algorithm: old Bstar complete outer path, then delay-group l2 ADMM terminal refit
group.lambda_rule: multiplier*sqrt(observed_sigma_base)*median(column norms); groups from estimated support delay IDs
group.stopping: existing primal/dual residual eps_abs1e-7 eps_rel1e-6; raises on cap

bounded-param.algorithm: old Bstar complete outer path then observed finite-grid hard-template terminal refit
bounded-param.grid: 9 fixed offsets -0.5..0.5 step0.125, clipped to Doppler[-2,2]
bounded-param.query_rule: one initial fit plus at most9*centers objective fits; actual counts saved
bounded-param.stopping: one sweep or finite-grid stationarity; no continuous/global optimum claim
bounded-param.eligibility: Successful completion within the fixed one-sweep/query budget is an eligible finite algorithm even when grid stationarity is false; report baseline_stationary separately. Initial Bstar SBL qualification still required.

common.budget_policy: same8 configurations and192 paired blocks for all families; common capacity40 and73 physical-query ceiling, actual solver/CE/BP/LDPC/F cost measured separately; iterations are not wall-time equivalence
common.stage_policy: B0/ridge/SBL change initial CE; group/parameterized refit final channel after old Bstar outer path. Stages intentionally differ to preserve existing strong methods; full cost includes refit and terminal decode
common.old_Bstar_initializer: existing ObservedReceiver sbl parameter.001; old20-EM cap unchanged for terminal families; convergence flag required
common.eligibility: Keep solver failures and all denominators. SBL EM and group ADMM require their declared convergence checks; completed fixed-budget hard parameter search does not require grid stationarity. Preserve this distinction when selecting qualified candidates.
common.additional_comparator_budget: Historical A2 and old Bstar full calls are separately quoted if not byte-identical to an existing complete candidate output; do not silently add them to7680 or count terminal-refit output as old Bstar.

high_compute_reference.budget: separate explicit F/E counts required before execution

selection.within_family: qualified configurations by empirical FER; exact ties by full measured mean cost then recipe ID; retain family representative uncertainty
selection.across_families: cost/performance Pareto comparison with frozen simultaneous paired confidence intervals; retain up to2 statistically indistinguishable deployable references, including stronger existing opponent
selection.ambiguity: All family representatives and paired intervals remain reported. Select up to2 concrete references for downstream comparison even when >2 are indistinguishable; do not claim unselected methods were statistically defeated.
selection.cost: same-round A2 denominator; old Bstar denominator also reported; engineering timing does not pass COST02

deterministic_references.first: lowest development FER among qualified budget-screened family representatives; exact ties by measured full mean cost then recipe ID
deterministic_references.second: among other family representatives not demonstrably worse in paired development intervals, smallest FER then measured full mean cost then recipe ID; prefer nondominated cost/performance point; none if no qualifying alternative
deterministic_references.cost_screen: engineering/development cost relative to original A2 is provisional, never formal COST-02 qualification
deterministic_references.retained_reports: all40 configurations and family representatives, including existing old comparators; no hiding uncertainty or false global optimality

selection.revision: clarify pre-data deterministic two-reference selection without artificial >2-unresolved blocker
